tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Page ground. About 70% of every page. Also the shadow colour of all footage and photos.

tokens.name: midnight-raised
tokens.usage: Menu overlay, picture frames and any surface that sits on midnight.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline rules between rows and around frames. Decorative only, never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: burgundy
tokens.usage: The loud colour, used as a FIELD: full-bleed sections, buttons, project tiles, the page-transition wipe. About 20% of a page. Text on it is ivory only (9:1). Never use it as text or a thin line on midnight (1.8:1). One exception: the loader's word cards (M01), monument-size and decorative, where the dim tone-on-tone is the point.

tokens.name: burgundy-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of burgundy, and the darker half of two-tone burgundy tiles. Ivory text only.

tokens.name: claret
tokens.usage: Burgundy for things set ON midnight: poster headlines, typed notes, the menu dot, the focus ring. 4:1 on midnight, so 24px and larger only. Never on a burgundy field.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: All reading text on midnight (15:1) and on burgundy (9:1). Also the highlight colour of footage and photos, and the ground of the few inverted cards (midnight text on it).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text and mono labels on midnight (7.5:1). Not on burgundy (4.2:1): use ivory there.

styles.name: monument
styles.usage: The page's title word, sized to fill the content width: below 810px MUKUND / MANGLA on two lines (content width / 3.24), from 810px MUKUND MANGLA on one line (content width / 6.66). The divisors are the name's measured width in em plus 1.6% to spare. The px value is the size at 1440px. Always uppercase.

styles.name: poster-1
styles.usage: Hero and closing headlines. Fluid: clamp(72px, 11vw + 28px, 180px).

styles.name: poster-2
styles.usage: Project names, section titles, the scrolling word list. Fluid: clamp(60px, 8.5vw + 28px, 128px).

styles.name: poster-3
styles.usage: Sub-section titles. Fluid: clamp(46px, 3.6vw + 32px, 84px). The takeover menu uses the menu style.

styles.name: poster-4
styles.usage: Headings inside case studies and list rows. Fluid: clamp(29px, 1.6vw + 22px, 44px).

styles.name: menu
styles.usage: The five links in the takeover menu and nothing else. Fluid: clamp(56px, 9vw, 150px).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: i build software front to back: the model, the backend and the screen.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of a page or case study.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: an ios app that tracks your training and your food in one place.
styles.usage: All running text. Lowercase voice, see the README.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: built over one summer, rewritten twice.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav, tags, frame numbers, button text, metadata. Always uppercase.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Stack lists and captions typed onto project tiles. Lowercase.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Margin notes in your own voice, tilted 2 to 5 degrees, in claret or ivory. At most three on a screen.

styles.name: scrawl
styles.usage: Large typed notes: the Lab note and the final note on Contact. Fluid: clamp(40px, 5.5vw, 72px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap between a label and its number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked menu links.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between an eyebrow label, a headline and its lede.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side padding on phones. Gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap before a call to action. Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop. Gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space above a poster headline.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Breathing room between the big moments of a page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Buttons, tiles, cards, inputs, sections are all square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Embedded media only: videos, screenshots, phone frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The floating contact button and nothing else.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding: space-4 on phones, space-10 from 810px. The monument size is worked out from it.

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: Height of the fixed nav.

tokens.name: nav-band
tokens.usage: A band at the top of the screen kept clear of the Work word wall, so the nav name and menu button always read.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Height of every Button.

tokens.name: ticker
tokens.usage: Height of the Ticker band on Home.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum size of any touch target.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, ghost button and tag borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring width. Claret on midnight, ivory on burgundy.

tokens.name: ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Thickness of the two lines of the menu button, and of its cross.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: Height of the reading progress line on case studies.

tokens.name: tile-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of a ProjectTile on the Work page.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of reading text.

tokens.name: md
tokens.usage: Below this every split is one column and nothing pins sideways. Side padding becomes space-10 from here up.

tokens.name: lg
tokens.usage: Full desktop layout.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for everything that arrives: text rolls, wipes, reveals.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Things that land with a small overshoot: tiles, stickers, the contact button.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Page-transition wipe and anything that both leaves and arrives.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity changes on hover and press.

tokens.name: dur-roll
tokens.usage: Letter roll on links, button fill, line reveals.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: Pop landings with ease-pop.

tokens.name: dur-page
tokens.usage: Page-transition wipe, each half.

tokens.name: stagger-letter
tokens.usage: Delay between neighbouring letters in a roll or a headline reveal.
